plain: Neil McCasland is a retired US Air Force general who, according to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, was extremely high up. Michels says McCasland ran the Air Force Research Laboratory at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base, and sat on a committee overseeing special access programs, the military's most secret projects. He also says McCasland was a source for Tom DeLonge, who wrote a set of books called Secret Machines that are labelled fiction. Michels says that in the 2020s McCasland went very mysteriously missing from his home in New Mexico. A journalist, Jeremy Corbell, says it too, pointing out that this man was charged with protecting national security and is now missing. So the story comes mainly from the host, told across several episodes, plus a journalist guest. Why it matters to them: if true, a man said to hold deep secrets has simply vanished.
